NOTHING dated 2026-09-29. DevDay keynote is 10:00 PT 2026-09-29 — after this scan ran.

0.158.0 body:
- MCP: connect to MCP servers that require PRE-REGISTERED OAuth CLIENT SECRETS, including
  via `codex mcp add --oauth-client-secret`. => Codex now holds OAuth client secrets locally.
- Direct exec-server WebSocket connections now support BEARER TOKEN authentication;
  support extended to app-server configured connections.
- Image gen/edit: explicit transparent backgrounds; edits accept file-backed conversation
  images.
- Terminal input approval ON BY DEFAULT for commands with elevated permissions.
- copy-on-select + right-click paste in the fullscreen TUI; copied transcript selections
  preserve Markdown formatting.
Fixes: Windows sandbox standard paths/credential handling, Linux sandbox startup with
nested writable roots, git metadata protection across multiple writable roots, macOS patch
system path aliases, approval-review retry on new input, Mermaid quoted labels/ampersands.
